verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's AI Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to similar past incidents and surfaces suggestions in Command Center/Slack (firehydrant-docs-30), and AI-generated summaries appear as soon as an incident is declared (firehydrant-docs-52), giving some 'before a human asks' correlation. However, there's no documented evidence of correlating code/config changes or live telemetry data as part of this investigative process — it's limited to incident-text similarity and summarization, not a full root-cause 'investigator' pulling from deploys/metrics. Missing for 10: evidence of correlating infrastructure/code changes, telemetry/metrics ingestion into the AI analysis, and an autonomous 'investigation' output beyond summaries and incident-similarity suggestions.
